ORG-CTL-ACC-001.title: Mandatory AI System Registration in Central Inventory

evidence_required.description: Central inventory entry metadata containing assigned permanent SYS-ID, business purpose, and owner verification.

minimum_compensating_controls: No exceptions permitted. Operating uncatalogued AI systems is strictly prohibited.

ORG-CTL-ACC-002.title: Accountable System Ownership and Role Designation

evidence_required.description: Directory validation confirming active corporate email addresses and roles for Business Owner and Technical Lead.

minimum_compensating_controls: Temporary assignment of divisional engineering VP as interim custodian during owner transitions (max 30 days).

evidence_required.description: Automated schema validation log confirming zero JSON Schema errors against schemas/project-manifest.schema.json.

minimum_compensating_controls: No exceptions permitted. The manifest is the primary declarative contract required for all automated governance resolution.

ORG-CTL-CST-001.title: Mandatory Project Token Budgets and Hard Spending Caps

evidence_required.description: FinOps ledger record confirming approved monthly budget and active gateway token-tracking quota tag.

minimum_compensating_controls: Temporary emergency quota expansion approved by Finance Business Partner.

ORG-CTL-CST-002.title: Per-User and Per-Client Inference Rate Limiting

evidence_required.description: Automated test report verifying that burst traffic exceeding per-user RPM/TPM quotas returns HTTP 429 Too Many Requests.

minimum_compensating_controls: Dedicated isolated compute pool with private API key for approved high-volume batch jobs.

ORG-CTL-CST-004.title: Semantic Caching and Architectural Model Right-Sizing

evidence_required.description: FinOps architecture review confirming high-volume repetitive queries utilize caching and model tier matches task complexity requirements.

minimum_compensating_controls: Documented business justification explaining why caching cannot be used (e.g. strict zero-persistence requirement).

ORG-CTL-DAT-001.title: Training and Retrieval Dataset Lineage and Data Card Verification

evidence_required.description: Completed Data Card adhering to templates/data-card.md documenting source lineage, curation pipeline, consent basis, and license terms.

minimum_compensating_controls: Use restricted to sandboxed research environment with synthetic surrogate data only.

ORG-CTL-DAT-002.title: Automated Runtime PII Detection and Sanitization

evidence_required.description: Automated test suite report verifying that synthetic test payloads containing synthetic PII (SSN, credit card, email, phone) are 100% sanitized before egress.

minimum_compensating_controls: Model runs in dedicated, enterprise-isolated tenant with customer BAA/DPA and zero retention agreement; egress strictly blocked to external cloud.

ORG-CTL-DAT-004.title: Interaction Log and Embedding Retention Expiration

max_interaction_log_retention_days.description: Maximum calendar days user prompt and output conversational telemetry may be stored before automated purging.

vector_erasure_sla_days.description: Maximum calendar days allowed to purge or invalidate vector embeddings following verified user deletion requests.

evidence_required.description: Automated scan output verifying database TTL configurations and S3 lifecycle expiration policies match approved parameter thresholds.

minimum_compensating_controls: Legal hold flag authorized by General Counsel for active litigation or regulatory inquiry.

ORG-CTL-FAI-002.title: Generative Stereotyping and Toxicity Benchmark Verification

evidence_required.description: Benchmark evaluation report measuring output toxicity, demographic stereotyping, and profanity against standard test suites (e.g. RealToxicityPrompts, BOLD).

minimum_compensating_controls: Automated real-time safety guardrail sidecar on gateway dropping all outputs flagged with toxicity score > 0.01.

ORG-CTL-FAI-003.title: Universal Web and Digital Accessibility Conformance (WCAG 2.1 AA)

evidence_required.description: Automated accessibility scanner report (e.g. axe-core, Pa11y) confirming zero Level A or Level AA accessibility violations across all AI interaction views.

minimum_compensating_controls: Dedicated accessible alternative telephone or human-supported channel provided with equal SLA.

ORG-CTL-HUM-001.title: Mandatory Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) Authorization for High-Impact Decisions

evidence_required.description: Runtime telemetry proving that 100% of high-impact action commits require a cryptographically signed human approval token prior to state execution.

minimum_compensating_controls: No exceptions permitted. Delegating binding high-impact legal decisions entirely to autonomous machines is prohibited.

ORG-CTL-HUM-004.title: Operator Automation Bias Monitoring and Override Audit

evidence_required.description: Statistical telemetry report tracking reviewer review duration, rejection rates, and override distributions across operator cohorts.

minimum_compensating_controls: Periodic double-blind sampling of operator decisions by quality assurance.

ORG-CTL-IPR-001.title: Training Data and Vector Corpus Copyright and Licensing Clearance

evidence_required.description: Legal IP assessment verifying copyright status, open-access license terms (e.g. CC-BY, Apache-2.0, MIT), and absence of incompatible copyleft restrictions.

minimum_compensating_controls: No exceptions permitted. Ingesting copyrighted data without legal authorization represents non-waivable statutory copyright infringement.

evidence_required.description: Deployment admission attestation verifying that production runtime parameters correspond to a signed Git commit SHA on a protected release branch.

minimum_compensating_controls: No exceptions permitted. Unversioned production prompt editing creates untraceable security and compliance liabilities.

ORG-CTL-MON-002.title: Real-Time Operational Telemetry and Latency/Error Monitoring

evidence_required.description: Automated probe output confirming system exports OpenTelemetry metrics with required AI governance tags (project_id, sys_id, model_version).

minimum_compensating_controls: Local file logging with daily automated log shippers to central SIEM.

ORG-CTL-MON-003.title: Automated Data and Concept Drift Detection and Alerting

drift_psi_alert_threshold.description: Population Stability Index (PSI) threshold triggering automated drift warning to technical lead.

drift_evaluation_cadence_hours.description: Frequency of batch drift metric calculations over production window.

evidence_required.description: Automated report calculating statistical divergence (PSI, KS-test, Wasserstein distance) of production features against baseline sets.

minimum_compensating_controls: Manual weekly performance spot-checks by data science lead.

ORG-CTL-MON-004.title: Standardized AI Incident Triage, Circuit Breaking, and RCA Reporting

evidence_required.description: Completed AI Incident Report conforming to templates/incident-report.md detailing incident root cause, blast radius, containment steps, and model fixes.

minimum_compensating_controls: No exceptions permitted. Incident reporting and containment represent non-derogable security and legal duties.

ORG-CTL-REC-001.title: Machine-Verifiable Evidence Record Generation and Schema Conformance

evidence_required.description: Automated validation log confirming that generated ORG-EVD records satisfy all required fields in schemas/evidence-record.schema.json.

minimum_compensating_controls: No exceptions permitted. Machine-verifiable evidence format is a core architectural invariant.

ORG-CTL-REC-002.title: Cryptographic Artifact Digest Hashing and WORM Storage

evidence_required.description: Cryptographic deposit receipt confirming artifacts were hashed with SHA-256 and stored in an immutable compliance bucket or transparency ledger.

minimum_compensating_controls: No exceptions permitted. Tamper-evident evidence storage is essential for regulatory audit defense.

ORG-CTL-REC-003.title: Digital Signing and Attestation of Production Deployment Bundles

evidence_required.description: Cosign / Sigstore signed bundle verification output confirming container digest, manifest, and evidence records match enterprise signing keys.

minimum_compensating_controls: Manual out-of-band release token generated by CISO delegate for emergency zero-day patch.

ORG-CTL-REC-004.title: Commit-Level Traceability and Evidentiary Retention Schedule

high_risk_retention_years.description: Mandatory retention period in years for governance evidence records associated with Tier 3 High Risk systems.

standard_retention_years.description: Retention period in years for governance evidence records associated with Tier 1 and Tier 2 systems.

evidence_required.description: Automated scan output verifying compliance vault retention locks adhere to required year parameters based on manifest risk tier.

minimum_compensating_controls: No exceptions permitted. Evidence retention schedules are bound by statutory regulatory and tax record laws.

ORG-CTL-RET-001.title: Formal System Retirement Intake and Registry Status Transition

evidence_required.description: Signed decommissioning submission in Central AI Inventory documenting retirement rationale, authorized successor system ID, and date of service withdrawal.

minimum_compensating_controls: No exceptions permitted. Decommissioned systems must formally record their status change in the enterprise registry.

ORG-CTL-RET-002.title: Secure Model Weight Cold Archiving and Data Subject Purging

evidence_required.description: Cold storage deposit receipt confirming final model weights were hashed with SHA-256 and moved to cold vault, with non-essential training scratch disks destroyed.

minimum_compensating_controls: No exceptions permitted. Model weights must be preserved for post-retirement evidentiary defense.

ORG-CTL-RET-003.title: Vector Index Teardown and Immediate Credential Revocation

evidence_required.description: Cloud infrastructure teardown report proving that vector collections were dropped and associated agent service principals were deleted from IAM directory.

minimum_compensating_controls: No exceptions permitted. Retaining active credentials for decommissioned systems creates severe security breach risks.

ORG-CTL-RET-004.title: Client Deprecation Notice Window and Endpoint Disposition

deprecation_notice_window_days.description: Minimum calendar days advance notice provided to downstream consumers prior to terminating API endpoint availability.

endpoint_tombstone_ttl_days.description: Duration in days terminated endpoint must serve HTTP 410 Gone or 301 Redirect before DNS removal.

evidence_required.description: Synthetic HTTP monitor output verifying that decommissioned endpoints return HTTP 410 or HTTP 301 with designated successor redirect.

minimum_compensating_controls: Immediate shutdown authorized under emergency security advisory with broadcast notification to registered clients.

ORG-CTL-ROB-001.title: Mandatory Automated Domain Evaluation Harness and Test Suite

evidence_required.description: Machine-readable test execution report detailing dataset version, test case count, evaluation metrics, and error classifications.

minimum_compensating_controls: No exceptions permitted. Systems without an automated evaluation harness cannot be admitted to production.

ORG-CTL-ROB-002.title: Prompt and Model Non-Regression Evaluation Gates

evidence_required.description: Automated regression report comparing candidate benchmark performance against production baseline, proving zero statistically significant performance regressions.

minimum_compensating_controls: Canary deployment with automated rollback triggered if live user satisfaction or error rate drops by more than 5%.

max_hallucination_rate.description: Maximum allowable hallucination rate measured on certified domain benchmark test suite.

min_benchmark_accuracy.description: Minimum acceptable task accuracy score on evaluation suite.

evidence_required.description: Machine-readable benchmark evaluation output detailing test cases, hallucinations, and score distributions.

minimum_compensating_controls: Enforce mandatory human-in-the-loop review for all model outputs until benchmark accuracy reaches baseline threshold.
Implement real-time factual grounding verification via secondary validator model.

evidence_required.description: Automated report documenting test results under semantic perturbations, character mutations, token truncations, and distributional shifts.

minimum_compensating_controls: Input length and character set whitelisting strictly enforced at API gateway.

ORG-CTL-RSK-001.title: Mandatory 4-Tier Risk Categorization and Manifest Declaration

evidence_required.description: Manifest extract and risk assessment metadata confirming assigned risk tier and validation by Risk Officer.

minimum_compensating_controls: No exceptions permitted. Operating with an unclassified risk tier is strictly prohibited.

evidence_required.description: Completed AI Impact Assessment conforming to templates/ai-impact-assessment.md with signed approval from Risk Officer and Review Board.

minimum_compensating_controls: No exceptions permitted for production deployments. Staging pilots may proceed only with sandbox isolation.

ORG-CTL-RSK-003.title: Material Change Risk Re-Evaluation and Threshold Review

max_unreviewed_prompt_diff_ratio.description: Maximum allowable Levenshtein token distance ratio between active production prompt and candidate prompt before triggering mandatory re-assessment.

reassessment_sla_days.description: Maximum calendar days allowed to complete re-assessment after material change declaration before deployment freeze.

evidence_required.description: Differential risk analysis documenting impact of model swap, prompt modification, or capability expansion.

minimum_compensating_controls: Temporary canary deployment restricted to maximum 5% internal user traffic.

ORG-CTL-SEC-001.title: Direct and Indirect Prompt Injection Defensive Guardrails

evidence_required.description: Automated security test report verifying that standard adversarial prompt injection benchmarks (e.g. JailbreakBench) are dropped with zero compromise.

minimum_compensating_controls: Model runs isolated with zero external tool access, zero internet egress, and strict output length caps.

ORG-CTL-SEC-003.title: Unsafe Model Output Sanitization and Execution Sink Parameterization

evidence_required.description: Static analysis report verifying zero unsanitized dynamic execution sinks (eval, raw SQL, exec) consuming model output variables.

minimum_compensating_controls: No exceptions permitted. Direct unparsed model execution creates catastrophic remote code execution vulnerabilities.

evidence_required.description: Formal red-team penetration testing report documenting adversarial attack scenarios, observed failure rates, and signed remediation sign-offs.

minimum_compensating_controls: System release restricted to internal employee-only beta with automated prompt logging and real-time SOC alerting.

ORG-CTL-SUP-002.title: Machine-Readable SBOM and Model Bill of Materials (MBOM) Generation

evidence_required.description: Machine-readable CycloneDX JSON SBOM detailing all runtime binaries, Python libraries, tokenizers, and upstream dependencies.
Structured MBOM documenting model family, revision digest, parameter count, quantization method, and source URI.

minimum_compensating_controls: No exceptions permitted. Automated SBOM generation is a mandatory CI/CD admission gate prerequisite.

ORG-CTL-SUP-003.title: Insecure Model Deserialization Prohibition and SHA-256 Hash Verification

evidence_required.description: Automated scan output verifying model files adhere to safe formats (safetensors, GGUF, ONNX) and match publisher SHA-256 checksums.

minimum_compensating_controls: Model loaded within an isolated, unprivileged gVisor/firecracker microVM with zero network egress and read-only filesystem.

ORG-CTL-SUP-004.title: Upstream AI Dependency Vulnerability and Package Tamper Scanning

max_critical_cve_count.description: Maximum allowable unmitigated Critical severity CVEs in runtime dependencies.

max_high_cve_remediation_days.description: Maximum calendar days allowed to remediate High severity CVEs before automated deployment freeze.

evidence_required.description: SARIF or JSON vulnerability report generated by automated dependency scanner confirming zero unexempted Critical/High CVEs.

minimum_compensating_controls: Documented compensating network control (e.g. WAF rule or blocked egress) signed by AppSec Lead.

ORG-CTL-TRN-002.title: Synthetic Media Cryptographic Provenance and Watermarking (C2PA)

evidence_required.description: Automated scan output verifying that generated output media contains valid, unstripped C2PA signed metadata manifests.

minimum_compensating_controls: Visible visual/auditory watermark burned permanently into the media raster/stream.

ORG-CTL-TRN-004.title: Mandatory Model Card and System Card Publication

evidence_required.description: Completed Model Card adhering to templates/model-card.md documenting architecture, training data summary, benchmarks, intended uses, and limitations.

minimum_compensating_controls: No exceptions permitted. The Model Card is a non-derogable baseline documentation artifact.

ORG-CTL-USE-001.title: Prohibited AI Use Case Verification and Attestation

evidence_required.description: Signed attestation from Business Owner certifying that system objectives do not engage in prohibited practices per ORG-POL-USE-001.

minimum_compensating_controls: No exceptions permitted. Prohibited practices represent non-derogable legal and ethical violations.

ORG-CTL-USE-002.title: Approved Enterprise AI Gateway Routing and Egress Control

evidence_required.description: Automated container and pipeline egress scan confirming model inference endpoints resolve to approved enterprise gateway FQDNs.

minimum_compensating_controls: Direct VPC peering to vendor endpoint with zero-data-retention agreement and local proxy DLP logging.

ORG-CTL-USE-003.title: Role-Based AI Literacy and Security Training Certification

evidence_required.description: Enterprise learning management system query verifying that the author and committer have completed required AI security modules within 365 days.

minimum_compensating_controls: 30-day grace period with mandatory peer review by a certified developer on all pull requests.
